summary: Verified Neon Highway swipe-gesture feature (/arcade/highway). Ran the provided Vitest game-logic suite (39/39 passed) and wrote/ran 5 new browser checks covering start/data-lane, CDP-emulated touch swipe lane changes, lane boundaries + keyboard/tap alt-controls, vertical-swipe/no-scroll isolation, and pause/resume gesture gating. Re-ran 3 pre-existing highway checks (public-preview, collision/game-over/restart, camera-toggle) to confirm no visual/functional regressions. All 8 acceptance_matrix criteria covered across 9 check artifacts (lane-boundaries criterion and alt-controls criterion combined into one check; pause/resume+game-over criterion split across two checks) - all passed, no bugs found.
action_items: spec_deviation (from briefing, unchanged): start overlay text intentionally still reads 'Tippe links oder rechts' (no UI text changes allowed); swipe support is additive only - not a bug.

seed_fact (from briefing, unchanged): guest/training round shows 'Nur Trainingsrunde – SQL 013 fehlt noch.' on game over because the remote Supabase migration SQL 013 was not run in this environment - expected, not a bug; coin/highscore persistence for guests cannot be verified here.

checks.criterion: Game logic unit tests (spawn fairness, difficulty ramp, hitboxes, gestures)
checks.name: vitest-highway-engine-and-gestures
checks.evidence: cd /app && npx vitest run --config node_modules/.cache/vitest.hw.config.mjs -> 'Test Files 2 passed (2)', 'Tests 39 passed (39)' (engine.test.ts 31 tests, gestures.test.ts 8 tests), Duration ~63s.

checks.criterion: Neon Highway at /arcade/highway starts a round (guest/training mode, no login needed)
checks.name: highway-start-sets-lane-one
checks.evidence: Guest nav to /arcade/highway -> start overlay visible, tap highway-start-overlay-button -> overlay hidden, canvas data-lane='1' asserted, score increased ('0'->higher) and time ('0s'->higher) over 2s. No login required.

checks.criterion: Swipe right / left on a touchscreen changes exactly one lane per gesture
checks.name: highway-swipe-left-right-one-lane
checks.evidence: Via CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent: ~150px right swipe moved data-lane 1->2; left swipe moved 2->1; a full-screen-width swipe (lane 1->2) and a within-one-gesture right-then-left reversal each produced exactly one net lane change (gesture 'done' flag in gestures.ts blocks a second change per touch id).

checks.name: highway-lane-boundaries-and-alt-controls
checks.evidence: At data-lane=2: swipe-right, tap-right-half, and ArrowRight key each kept lane at '2'. At data-lane=0: swipe-left, tap-left-half, and ArrowLeft key each kept lane at '0'. ArrowRight from 0 moved to '1'. Also covers 'Alternative controls kept' (tap halves + arrow keys) in the same flow.

checks.name: highway-vertical-swipe-no-lane-change-no-scroll
checks.evidence: CDP-emulated 200px down-swipe and 200px up-swipe on the canvas: data-lane stayed '1' both times, window.scrollY === 0 after each, game continued running (score positive).

checks.name: highway-pause-ignores-gestures-resume-works
checks.evidence: highway-pause-button -> highway-pause-overlay visible; a 150px right swipe while paused left data-lane at '1' (ignored); tapping 'Weiter' (highway-pause-overlay-button) hid the overlay; the same swipe gesture afterward moved data-lane '1'->'2', confirming gestures work again after resume.

checks.criterion: Pause/resume and game over (collision/restart part, pre-existing check, re-run for regression)
checks.name: neon-highway-collision-gameover-restart
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: natural collision -> highway-game-over visible with 'Nur Trainingsrunde – SQL 013 fehlt noch.' and a numeric score; highway-restart-button hid the overlay and reset score to ~0.

checks.criterion: Visuals unchanged (camera toggle + public preview, pre-existing checks, re-run for regression)
checks.name: neon-highway-camera-toggle
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: toggle switches 'Heck'<->'Oben', no accidental lane change/game-over from the toggle click, localStorage persistence across reload confirmed.

checks.criterion: Visuals unchanged (synthwave scene on public preview URL, pre-existing check, re-run for regression)
checks.name: neon-highway-public-preview
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check against https://leonida-karte--6tt5kohx.preview.emergentagent.com/arcade/highway: start overlay, start flow, and rising score all confirmed on the public ingress URL.
